grainmeasure_hat.flavour: Straw-pale and dusty. Measure the grain. The grain has never lied to this hat.

doorkeeper_helm.name: Doorkeeper's Helm
doorkeeper_helm.flavour: Plain iron, dented from the inside. Keep the door, the Commander says, and some do.

ford_wader_hat.name: Ford-wader's Hat
ford_wader_hat.flavour: Oilcloth, green at the seams. Dry head, wet boots, and a good day at the Ford.

bellmire_felt.name: Bellmire Felt
bellmire_felt.flavour: The town's plain felt cap. Ugly, warm, and you will see forty of them at the feast.

pilgrims_wide.name: Pilgrim's Wide Hat
pilgrims_wide.flavour: Brim wide enough to hide a prayer in. The scar draws pilgrims, and they are never sure why.

raiders_bane_helm.name: Raidbreaker's Helm
raiders_bane_helm.flavour: Dented at the crown by a thrown axe. The wearer says it was a very bad throw.

festival_garland.name: Festival Garland
festival_garland.flavour: Green leaves, red ribbon, wilting by the third toast. Bellmire wears it anyway.

harvest_crown.name: Harvest Crown
harvest_crown.flavour: Braided wheat, gilded at the tips. Worn by whoever brings in the last cart.

delvers_lamp_cap.name: Delver's Lamp Cap
delvers_lamp_cap.flavour: A cap with a lamp-hook sewn to it. The wearer has been below, and wants you to know it.

scarmarked_hood.name: Scar-marked Hood
scarmarked_hood.flavour: Dyed with something dredged from the scar. It looks black in the sun and purple in the torchlight.

wall_walker_cap.name: Wall-walker's Cap
wall_walker_cap.flavour: Chin-strapped against the wind. Walkers of the new wall wear it, and do not look down.

barracks_cap.name: Barracks Cap
barracks_cap.flavour: Red wool, guard-issue. E3PO has been seen to approve of it, which is rare.

miller_felt.name: Miller's Felt
miller_felt.flavour: White with flour to the elbow. This hat never goes to the scar and is proud of it.

beekeepers_veil.name: Beekeeper's Veil
beekeepers_veil.flavour: Net, brim and a smoker pot's worth of patience. The bees have never once been rushed.

tithe_collector_hat.name: Tithe-collector's Hat
tithe_collector_hat.flavour: Stiff and square. People cross the road when they see it, and it takes that as a compliment.

watchfire_hood.name: Watchfire Hood
watchfire_hood.flavour: Red as a beacon. Seen from the wall, it means somebody is awake who should be.

cartwright_flat_cap.name: Cartwright's Flat Cap
cartwright_flat_cap.flavour: Wheel-grease on the peak. Every caravan that reaches Bellmire owes someone in this cap.

bell_ringer_hat.name: Bell-ringer's Hat
bell_ringer_hat.flavour: Padded against the din. The great bell has no clapper, the ringer says, and rings it anyway.

mourners_black_veil.name: Mourner's Black Veil
mourners_black_veil.flavour: Black gauze, light as breath. The chapel bell rings for a hero, and this comes out.

banner_scar_mouth.name: Scar-mouth Banner
banner_scar_mouth.flavour: Hung over the stair-head. It flaps toward the dark, though there is no wind below.

banner_guild_post.name: Guild Post Banner
banner_guild_post.flavour: Red, with the guild's open door. The hinge is stitched in gold, because it is the part that matters.

banner_flask_count.name: Flask-count Banner
banner_flask_count.flavour: A tally of little flasks, stitched in rows. Count them. Then count them again.

banner_door_kept.name: Door-kept Banner
banner_door_kept.flavour: Grey, one door, one bar. Keep the door.

banner_grain_measured.name: Grain-measure Banner
banner_grain_measured.flavour: A bushel in tawny thread. It is the first thing stitched on the first flag of the first day.

banner_ford_crossing.name: Ford Crossing Banner
banner_ford_crossing.flavour: Blue, one wavering line. The river is the oldest road in Bellmire.

banner_wall_first.name: First Wall Banner
banner_wall_first.flavour: A wall, unfinished, drawn in a hurry by someone who was afraid it would not be finished.

banner_commander.name: Commander's Banner
banner_commander.flavour: A raised fist, a helm, and a long list of things E3PO is not impressed by.

banner_raid_held.name: Raid-held Banner
banner_raid_held.flavour: Scorch along the hem, flown the morning after a raid. The walls held, it says.

banner_feast_night.name: Feast-night Banner
banner_feast_night.flavour: Torch-orange, cup and loaf. Hung at the long table, dripped on by the third toast.

banner_harvest_cart.name: Harvest-cart Banner
banner_harvest_cart.flavour: The last cart, drawn heavy. A good year, plainly, and a hungry one to come.

banner_caravan_road.name: Caravan Road Banner
banner_caravan_road.flavour: Wheels and a long road. Hung on the gate when the carts are due.

banner_lord_felled.name: Lord-felled Banner
banner_lord_felled.flavour: A crown, struck through. Raised the day a dungeon lord goes down.

banner_hero_home.name: Hero-home Banner
banner_hero_home.flavour: A cloak walking out of a dark door. The town hangs it for anyone who comes back.

banner_chapel_bell.name: Chapel Bell Banner
banner_chapel_bell.flavour: One bell, no clapper. The town has an opinion about this, and it is stitched in thread.

banner_smiths_mark.name: Smith's Mark Banner
banner_smiths_mark.flavour: A hammer in an ember field. Steel is the only argument that wins.

banner_scarforged.name: Scarforged Banner
banner_scarforged.flavour: Purple-black, thread that hums faintly when the scar is near. Do not hang it indoors.

banner_ledger_black.name: Ledger Banner
banner_ledger_black.flavour: Plain black, a white quill. The guild writes down every name, and every name is on this.

title_flaskcounting.name: the Flask-counter
title_flaskcounting.flavour: He counted the flasks, and the flasks added up, which is rarer than it sounds.

title_doorkeeper.name: the Doorkeeper
title_doorkeeper.flavour: Kept the door when something leaned on it from the other side.

title_grainmeasurer.name: the Grainmeasurer
title_grainmeasurer.flavour: Measured the grain honestly through three lean winters. The town noticed.

title_lanternman.name: the Lanternman
title_lanternman.flavour: Lit the stair at dusk. Somebody had to be the first to see what came up.

title_scarwatcher.name: the Scarwatcher
title_scarwatcher.flavour: Watched the scar until it began to watch back.

title_ledgerkeeper.name: the Ledger-keeper
title_ledgerkeeper.flavour: Wrote down every name that went below. The ink never ran.

title_wallwalker.name: the Wall-walker
title_wallwalker.flavour: Walked the wall at the dead hour, because doors open at the dead hour.

title_gatebreaker.name: the Gate-holder
title_gatebreaker.flavour: Stood in the gateway when the raiders came, and the gateway held.

title_feastmaster.name: the Feastmaster
title_feastmaster.flavour: Declared the feast, filled the cups, and was not seen sober until morning.

title_harvestlord.name: the Harvest-lord
title_harvestlord.flavour: Brought in the last cart. Bellmire ate, and remembered who drove.

title_homecomer.name: the Homecomer
title_homecomer.flavour: Walked out of the scar when the town had stopped lighting the lamp for them.

title_lordfeller.name: the Lordfeller
title_lordfeller.flavour: A dungeon lord has a past tense now, and this is why.

title_fordkeeper.name: the Ford-keeper
title_fordkeeper.flavour: Knew which stones held and which did not, and said so before the flood.

title_caravaneer.name: the Caravaneer
title_caravaneer.flavour: Brought wagons to a town that was not sure it deserved them.

title_hearthwarden.name: the Hearthwarden
title_hearthwarden.flavour: The guild-post fire never went out on this one's watch.

title_tithewarden.name: the Tithe-warden
title_tithewarden.flavour: Collected honestly, which made them very lonely.

title_scarmarked.name: the Scar-marked
title_scarmarked.flavour: Marked by the scar, and not entirely sorry for it.

title_stairwalker.name: the Stair-walker
title_stairwalker.flavour: Down and up, and down again. The stair knows the tread by now.

title_candlewright.name: the Candlewright
title_candlewright.flavour: A candle is a promise to be back before it burns out.

title_wellwisher.name: the Well-wisher
title_wellwisher.flavour: Dropped a coin in the well and meant it, which is all the well asks.

title_oathkeeper.name: the Oathkeeper
title_oathkeeper.flavour: Swore on the guild post's door and did not come off the oath.

title_crosswarden.name: the Crosswarden
title_crosswarden.flavour: Held the crossing on the day it became a town.

title_bellmirian.name: the Bellmirian
title_bellmirian.flavour: A plain word, with a plain pride in it. Count the flasks.

pet_gatehound.name: a gate hound
pet_gatehound.flavour: Barks once at strangers and twice at strangers carrying cheese.

pet_guildpup.name: a guild pup
pet_guildpup.flavour: Born under the guild post's table. It has opinions on the ledger.

pet_stoutpug.name: a stout pug
pet_stoutpug.flavour: Snores through raids. The Commander says that is discipline.

pet_scarpug.name: a scar-sniffing pug
pet_scarpug.flavour: Sits at the stair-head and sneezes at the dark. The dark has never replied.

pet_packllama.name: a pack llama
pet_packllama.flavour: Carries the caravan's grudges and most of its salt.

pet_festivalllama.name: a festival llama
pet_festivalllama.flavour: Wears ribbons to the feast and spits only at the deserving.

title_ascender.name: the Ascender
title_ascender.flavour: Climbed out on your own legs. Nothing carried you.

title_longclimb.name: of the Long Climb
title_longclimb.flavour: Every stair back up was paid for. You paid.

title_stairsore.name: Stair-sore
title_stairsore.flavour: Knees remember the way out better than the map does.

title_stonebought.name: who Bought the Stone
title_stonebought.flavour: Paid before the gamble. It cracked where you stood. You stood.

title_stonesaved.name: Stone-spent
title_stonesaved.flavour: One stone, one hero. You were the one.

title_lordsfloor.name: who Went without a Stone
title_lordsfloor.flavour: The stone is dead weight on a lord's floor. You knew, and went.

title_errandrunner.name: the Errand-runner
title_errandrunner.flavour: Bought the thing, then walked to fetch it. Nobody carries it for you.

title_orderslip.name: Order-slip in Hand
title_orderslip.flavour: Paid at the counter. Collected at the door. In that order.

title_vaultkeeper.name: Keeper of the Vault
title_vaultkeeper.flavour: The Guild Vault holds what you could not carry. You hold the key.

title_lightpacked.name: the Light-packed
title_lightpacked.flavour: Carried less, came back with more. The scale agrees.

title_overladen.name: the Overladen
title_overladen.flavour: Too much on the back. The stair counted every ounce.

title_shelfstocker.name: the Shelf-stocker
title_shelfstocker.flavour: Filled the Guild shelves before the town asked.

title_cartfull.name: Cart-full
title_cartfull.flavour: Came in behind the caravan and out ahead of the tally.

title_reeveguest.name: Guest of the Reeve
title_reeveguest.flavour: Dined at the Reeve's table. Paid for your own ale.

title_marketcross.name: of the Market Cross
title_marketcross.flavour: Stood at the cross on market day and was not moved.

title_stonebridge.name: of the Stone Bridge
title_stonebridge.flavour: The old planks are gone. The stone holds. So did you.

title_wallwarden.name: Warden of the New Wall
title_wallwarden.flavour: Dressed stone, set true. Your name is on a course of it.

title_guildhallseat.name: Seat in the Guild Hall
title_guildhallseat.flavour: A chair with your name cut into the back. The town is not poor now.

title_councilbench.name: of the Council Bench
title_councilbench.flavour: Spoke once, was heard, and the bench was glad of it.

title_charterman.name: Charter-bearer
title_charterman.flavour: The charter is sealed and the seal is good. You carried it down the road.

title_cleartiles.name: of the Slate Roofs
title_cleartiles.flavour: Thatch gave way to slate. The rain stopped getting in.

title_lampstreet.name: of Lamp Street
title_lampstreet.flavour: Every post lit, every night. You paid for the oil, and the rest followed.

title_wellfed.name: the Well-fed
title_wellfed.flavour: A full granary and the bread to show for it.

title_cellarfull.name: Cellar-full
title_cellarfull.flavour: Casks to the rafters. The Brewster nods when you pass.

title_greatfair.name: of the Great Fair
title_greatfair.flavour: The fair filled the road for three days. You were at the head of it.

title_goldenbell.name: the Gilded Bell
title_goldenbell.flavour: The bell was cast in bronze and gilded in your honour. It still rings plain.

title_firstgentleman.name: First of the Hall
title_firstgentleman.flavour: The long table, the high seat. Bellmire can afford one now.

title_townfather.name: Father of the Town
title_townfather.flavour: Fifty families, then five hundred. All of them know your name.

title_hearthmended.name: the Hearth-mended
title_hearthmended.flavour: Patched the roof, relit the fire. Warm again.

title_firstfrost.name: First-frost Watch
title_firstfrost.flavour: On the wall before the ice came. Off it after.

title_gravetender.name: the Gravetender
title_gravetender.flavour: Kept the stones upright and the names legible.

title_oilbearer.name: the Oil-bearer
title_oilbearer.flavour: Carried lamp oil down and carried the lamp back up.

title_lastlamp.name: the Last Lamp Out
title_lastlamp.flavour: Put the last lamp out and walked home by the ones that were left.

title_hushed.name: the Hushed
title_hushed.flavour: Did not boast. The Chronicler wrote it down anyway.

title_slowhand.name: Slow-handed
title_slowhand.flavour: Never rushed a lock, a bow, or a bill. Never regretted it.

title_notthrice.name: Not Thrice Fooled
title_notthrice.flavour: Twice is a lesson. A third time is a habit. You kept the lesson.

title_halfflask.name: Half a Flask Left
title_halfflask.flavour: Enough to come home on. Not enough to be sure.

title_noisehunter.name: the Mouse-eared
title_noisehunter.flavour: Heard the trap before it sprang. Told no one how.

title_tendoors.name: Ten Doors Deep
title_tendoors.flavour: The tenth door opened. The hinges had been oiled for you.

title_soldwell.name: Sold at Fair Weight
title_soldwell.flavour: Never cheated a scale. The scales never cheated you.

title_gleaner.name: the Gleaner
title_gleaner.flavour: Took what the field left. The field did not mind.

title_boundwalker.name: the Boundwalker
title_boundwalker.flavour: Walked the town's edge at first light. Beat the bounds, kept the peace.

title_candlenub.name: Candle-nub
title_candlenub.flavour: A short end of wick, and the dark did not win. Not yet.

title_stilldark.name: Still Dark Below
title_stilldark.flavour: Came up. The dark stayed down. You hold it to that.

title_noonrest.name: who Rested at Noon
title_noonrest.flavour: Sat in the shade and ate your bread. The day was not lost.

title_wardstone.name: of the Ward-stone
title_wardstone.flavour: Set the stone at the door. It has held since.

title_masterkeys.name: Master of the Keys
title_masterkeys.flavour: Every door in Bellmire opens for you. Most never needed to be locked.

title_hallbuilt.name: who Raised the Hall
title_hallbuilt.flavour: Timber from the north wood, stone from the quarry. You paid the carters.

shop_stock._note_tier: Each entry also carries "tier": the growth tier at which this good first appears on a shelf, 1-12, matching lore_lines.growth_tiers. It is the SAME gate as stock_by_tier.shop_adds (the two are generated together and must agree) - this key is here so a shop can filter its own stock with good.tier <= town_tier instead of building a reverse map. Cumulative: a tier-N shop shows every good with tier <= N. Added C-cycle 7.
shop_stock._note: Shop display stock (D35/D39) - everyday goods a shop shows on its shelves. Keyed {name,cost,flavour} like the rest of the file. Dead until wired.

grain.name: Sack of Grain
grain.flavour: Measured, counted, sold by the sack.

lampoil.name: Flask of Oil
lampoil.flavour: For the lamps. Count them twice.

ale.name: Jug of Ale
ale.flavour: The tavern's own. Cloudy and honest.

wool.name: Bolt of Wool
wool.flavour: Grey, like everything the guild wears.

nails.name: Keg of Nails
nails.flavour: The masons buy them by the keg.

hooks.name: Fishhooks
hooks.flavour: For the river. Mind the Grinning Carp.

lantern.name: Tin Lantern
lantern.flavour: Keeps a flame in the wind off the scar.

firewood.name: Cord of Firewood
firewood.flavour: Split, stacked, and sold before the frost.

fish.name: String of River Fish
fish.flavour: Caught above the ford, where the water still runs clean.

cheese.name: Round of Cheese
cheese.flavour: Hard, pale, keeps a month in a cold room.

whetstone.name: Whetstone
whetstone.flavour: A blade is only as sharp as the last man who sat down with this.

blanket.name: Wool Blanket
blanket.flavour: Grey. Heavy. Worth every coin in the second week of winter.

pottery.name: Stack of Crockery
pottery.flavour: Fired at Craft Row. Chipped before it reaches the table.

boots.name: Pair of Boots
boots.flavour: Cobbled for the mire, not for the dance floor.

ink.name: Pot of Ink
ink.flavour: Oak gall and soot. The Chronicle drinks it by the pot.

parchment.name: Sheaf of Parchment
parchment.flavour: Scraped thin. A name fits on a very small piece.

leather.name: Hide of Leather
leather.flavour: Tanned on the downwind side of town, for good reason.

arrows.name: Sheaf of Arrows
arrows.flavour: Twenty-four, fletched grey. The garrison counts them back.

shield.name: Plain Shield
shield.flavour: Lime-wood, hide rim, no device. Devices get you noticed.

spice_twist.name: Twist of Spice
spice_twist.flavour: A thimble of somewhere warmer, sold by the thimble.

sweets.name: Box of Sugared Peel
sweets.flavour: Market-day money, gone by market-day dusk.

glass_pane.name: Pane of Glass
glass_pane.flavour: A window instead of a shutter. That is what a wall buys you.

physic.name: Apothecary's Physic
physic.flavour: Measured, corked, and written down in her ledger.

mirror.name: Hand Mirror
mirror.flavour: Polished tin. Bellmire can finally afford to look at itself.

sandglass.name: Sand-glass
sandglass.flavour: The hour, in a bottle. The guild has opinions about the hour now.

silk_kerchief.name: Silk Kerchief
silk_kerchief.flavour: Sold a square at a time, to people who were lately peasants.

eggs.name: Basket of Eggs
eggs.flavour: Still warm. Count them before you pay.

waterskin.name: Waterskin
waterskin.flavour: Filled above the ford. Below it, you would not.

butter.name: Crock of Butter
butter.flavour: Churned this morning, gone by this evening.

net.name: Fishing Net
net.flavour: Mended more times than it was ever woven.

tallow.name: Tub of Tallow
tallow.flavour: Lamp fat. Burns dirty, burns cheap, burns.

sealing_wax.name: Block of Sealing Wax
sealing_wax.flavour: The guild post has a door, and the door has letters.

preserves.name: Jar of Preserves
preserves.flavour: Last summer in a jar, kept for the worst of the winter.

besom.name: Besom Broom
besom.flavour: Twigs and twine. Every doorway in Bellmire owns one.

ribbon.name: Reel of Ribbon
ribbon.flavour: Market-day colour, and the first thing bought with a girl's own coin.

handscales.name: Hand Scales
handscales.flavour: Brass pans, honest beam. Measure the grain.

mourning_cloth.name: Length of Mourning Cloth
mourning_cloth.flavour: Sold by the yard. The chapel keeps a stock. So does the mason.

psalter.name: Chapel Psalter
psalter.flavour: Copied by hand. The bell has no clapper, so the book does the singing.

bellows.name: Hand Bellows
bellows.flavour: Leather and ash-wood. A forge is a fire somebody keeps breathing.

hide_glue.name: Pot of Hide Glue
hide_glue.flavour: Smells like the tannery, because it is the tannery.

smith_file.name: Smith's File
smith_file.flavour: Cuts iron slowly, which is the only way iron is cut.

helm.name: Plain Helm
helm.flavour: Garrison issue, unpainted. The dents come free.

bowstrings.name: Spare Bowstrings
bowstrings.flavour: Waxed, coiled, three to a packet. The wet eats the first.

soap.name: Cake of Scented Soap
soap.flavour: A market town can afford to smell like something other than a market.

figs.name: Box of Dried Figs
figs.flavour: Came up the road in a crate stamped in a language nobody here reads.

lock.name: Iron Lock and Key
lock.flavour: A wall is only a wall if the gate shuts. Same goes for a door.

mortar.name: Barrel of Mortar
mortar.flavour: Lime, sand, and the reason the first wall is still standing.

brass_lamp.name: Brass Lamp
brass_lamp.flavour: Hangs in a hall, not on a pole. The lamplighters sniff at it.

spectacles.name: Pair of Spectacles
spectacles.flavour: Two ground lenses in wire. The Chronicle's scribe wept.

pepper.name: Pepper Mill
pepper.flavour: Ground at the table, in front of guests. That is the entire point.

carpet.name: Patterned Carpet
carpet.flavour: Woven somewhere with no mire in it. Wipe your boots.

altar_oil.name: Flask of Altar Oil
altar_oil.flavour: Burns clear and slow. The chapel will not sell you the cheap stuff.

oilcloth.name: Oilcloth Cape
oilcloth.flavour: Keeps a bowstring dry, which keeps an archer useful.

comb.name: Bone Comb
comb.flavour: Carved at the stall while you wait. Mind the teeth.

iron_hinges.name: Set of Iron Hinges
iron_hinges.flavour: A gate is two hinges and an argument about who shuts it.

pewter_set.name: Pewter Table Set
pewter_set.flavour: Plates that match. Bellmire has opinions about plates that match.

glass_goblets.name: Pair of Glass Goblets
glass_goblets.flavour: Drinking from glass, in a town that drank from horn a lifetime ago.

clay_cups.name: Clay Cups
clay_cups.flavour: Thrown wet, dried in the sun, chipped by Thursday.

onions.name: Rope of Onions
onions.flavour: Hung from a beam until wanted. The whole hut smells of them.

straw.name: Bale of Straw
straw.flavour: Bedding for the beast, and for whoever lost the argument.

milk.name: Pail of Milk
milk.flavour: Carried up from the pen without spilling, which is the whole trick.

honey.name: Pot of Honey
honey.flavour: Robbed from the skeps by the well. Worth the stings.

flax.name: Bundle of Flax
flax.flavour: Retted in the river, spun by the fire, worn until it falls off.

ledger.name: Guild Ledger
ledger.flavour: Ruled, bound, and feared. The post keeps everything in it.

pitch.name: Bucket of Pitch
pitch.flavour: Seals a roof, a boot, or a boat. Mostly the boot.

lamp_wick.name: Reel of Lamp Wick
lamp_wick.flavour: Cut to length by the lamplighter, who has opinions about length.

bacon.name: Flitch of Bacon
bacon.flavour: Smoked in the rafters since autumn. Counted by the slice.

shears.name: Pair of Shears
shears.flavour: Sheep first, hair second, and nobody washes them between.

vinegar.name: Jug of Vinegar
vinegar.flavour: For the pickling and for the wound. Same jug, different day.

tally_sticks.name: Bundle of Tally Sticks
tally_sticks.flavour: Split, notched, and matched. A promise you cannot argue with.

stall_canvas.name: Stall Canvas
stall_canvas.flavour: Market-day roof. Sheds rain, not gossip.

bell_rope.name: Bell Rope
bell_rope.flavour: The bell has no clapper. They pull it anyway, and the town stands up.

grave_marker.name: Carved Grave Marker
grave_marker.flavour: The mason cuts the name and leaves the date to the scar.

censer.name: Brass Censer
censer.flavour: Swung slow. Smoke covers a great deal.

pit_saw.name: Two-Man Pit Saw
pit_saw.flavour: Takes two men to use and three to argue about.

potters_clay.name: Load of Potter's Clay
potters_clay.flavour: Dug from the riverbank, trodden barefoot, fired at the Row.

forge_apron.name: Leather Forge Apron
forge_apron.flavour: Scorched in the shape of its last owner.

watch_horn.name: Watch Horn
watch_horn.flavour: One blast for raiders, two for fire. Three and you run.

caltrops.name: Bag of Caltrops
caltrops.flavour: Scattered at dusk, gathered at dawn, counted both times.

field_bandages.name: Roll of Field Bandages
field_bandages.flavour: The garrison buys them by the roll and still runs short.

almonds.name: Sack of Sugared Almonds
almonds.flavour: Came up the road with the figs and twice the price.

dyed_sash.name: Dyed Sash
dyed_sash.flavour: Colour a labourer can afford, worn where it shows.

door_bar.name: Oak Door Bar
door_bar.flavour: A wall is a rumour until something drops into the brackets.

gate_tar.name: Barrel of Gate Tar
gate_tar.flavour: Painted on the gate each spring. It stinks, and the gate lasts.

street_lamp.name: Iron Street Lamp
street_lamp.flavour: Set along the wall road. The lamplighters drank to it for a week.

writing_desk.name: Folding Writing Desk
writing_desk.flavour: Travels with the guild's clerk and outranks him.

kid_gloves.name: Pair of Kid Gloves
kid_gloves.flavour: Thin enough to feel a coin through. That is the point.

apothecary_jar.name: Apothecary Jar
apothecary_jar.flavour: Lidded, labelled, and not to be opened by the curious.

lute.name: Painted Lute
lute.flavour: Bought by a man who fully intends to learn.

tapestry.name: Wall Tapestry
tapestry.flavour: A hunt nobody here has ever been on, hung where guests must pass.

reed_thatch.name: Bundle of Thatch
reed_thatch.flavour: Reed off the fen, cut short and bound tight. Every roof here starts as this.

clay_pot.name: Clay Cooking Pot
clay_pot.flavour: Fired brown, mended once already. It will outlive the cookfire.

laying_hen.name: A Laying Hen
laying_hen.flavour: Sold with her character described honestly, which is rare in a market.

sack_beans.name: Sack of Beans
sack_beans.flavour: What a household eats in the weeks the grain does not stretch.

guild_chit.name: Guild Chit
guild_chit.flavour: Brass, stamped with the post's mark. It means somebody vouched for you.

leather_awl.name: Leather Awl
leather_awl.flavour: Bone handle, worn to a thumbprint. A post without one mends nothing.

iron_spade.name: Iron Spade
iron_spade.flavour: A village is a place with enough spades to dig and bury in the same week.

beeswax_cake.name: Cake of Beeswax
beeswax_cake.flavour: For thread, for boots, for the chapel. Nothing here is wasted twice.

market_weight.name: Market Weight
market_weight.flavour: True to the grain and stamped to prove it. The stall that fakes one closes.

stall_bell.name: Stall Bell
stall_bell.flavour: Rung to open, rung to close. In between it is rung for the sheer joy of it.

votive_candle.name: Votive Candle
votive_candle.flavour: Lit for a name. The chapel keeps the names; the candle only keeps the hour.

prayer_beads.name: String of Beads
prayer_beads.flavour: Pear-wood, counted smooth. Most of the counting was done waiting on news.

rivet_box.name: Box of Rivets
rivet_box.flavour: Craft Row runs on these and on nobody admitting how often one fails.

glue_pot.name: Glue Pot
glue_pot.flavour: Kept warm all day. The smell is the price of everything else on the Row.

guard_whistle.name: Guard's Whistle
guard_whistle.flavour: One blast is a question. Two is the wall. Nobody blows three twice.

drill_pike.name: Drill Pike
drill_pike.flavour: Blunted on purpose. The Commander insists the drill hurt only a little.

ginger_knob.name: Knob of Ginger
ginger_knob.flavour: Came upriver in a crate that cost more than the cart. A market town smells of it.

sealed_crock.name: Sealed Crock
sealed_crock.flavour: Waxed shut. Whatever is inside keeps a season, which is the whole trick.

wall_chalk.name: Box of Wall-chalk
wall_chalk.flavour: For marking the courses, and for the names somebody adds at the end of a shift.

crane_rope.name: Crane Rope
crane_rope.flavour: Three-strand, tested to a weight nobody wants to see it hold.

paving_maul.name: Paving Maul
paving_maul.flavour: A town with paved streets is a town that stopped expecting to move.

shutter_lock.name: Shutter Lock
shutter_lock.flavour: Sold briskly ever since the walls went up and people found new things to fear.

pomander.name: Pomander
pomander.flavour: Cloves in a silver cage, carried by people who can afford to dislike the smell.

gilt_frame.name: Gilt Frame
gilt_frame.flavour: Empty. The buyer has a face in mind and will not say whose.

kindling.name: Bundle of Kindling
kindling.flavour: Twigs and bark. The first thing a fire asks for.

rush_light.name: Rush Light
rush_light.flavour: A peeled rush dipped in fat. Burns the length of a short argument.

wooden_bowl.name: Alder Bowl
wooden_bowl.flavour: Turned on a pole lathe. One to a mouth, and no spares.

oat_cake.name: Oat Cake
oat_cake.flavour: Hard enough to mend a cart. Eaten anyway.

cabbage.name: Head of Cabbage
cabbage.flavour: Heavy, pale, and boiled until it gives up.

smoked_eel.name: Smoked Eel
smoked_eel.flavour: Pulled from the weir, hung over the fire a day and a night.

oak_pail.name: Oak Pail
oak_pail.flavour: Stave-built, hooped in ash. It carries water, milk, and blame.

hurdle.name: Wattle Hurdle
hurdle.flavour: Hazel rods, woven. A fence you can carry and a wall you cannot.

waxed_thread.name: Reel of Waxed Thread
waxed_thread.flavour: Strong enough for boots and for the guild's patience.

slate_chalk.name: Slate and Chalk
slate_chalk.flavour: Sums wiped clean each night. The ledger keeps the real ones.

letter_case.name: Leather Letter-case
letter_case.flavour: Holds a post's worth of promises. Rain is the only reader it fears.

travel_satchel.name: Travel Satchel
travel_satchel.flavour: Cut for the road. Buckles stiff, straps honest.

oat_flour.name: Sack of Oat Flour
oat_flour.flavour: Stone-ground at the village mill. Porridge for a week, or a poultice.

pickled_eggs.name: Jar of Pickled Eggs
pickled_eggs.flavour: Sharp, grey, and the tavern's only reliable argument.

pattens.name: Pair of Pattens
pattens.flavour: Wooden overshoes that lift a boot out of the mire. Clack, clack, clack.

hay_fork.name: Hay Fork
hay_fork.flavour: Two tines, one handle, and a proud ash grain.

mutton_pie.name: Mutton Pie
mutton_pie.flavour: Hot at noon, a rumour by dusk. Ask what the mutton was.

market_basket.name: Market Basket
market_basket.flavour: Willow, twice-woven. Carries the day's bargains and the day's regrets.

leather_belt.name: Leather Belt
leather_belt.flavour: A buckle, a hole too few, and a pouch hung where thieves look first.

toy_horse.name: Wooden Toy Horse
toy_horse.flavour: Painted grey and chewed by three owners. The fourth is already waiting.

font_water.name: Phial of Font Water
font_water.flavour: Blessed on the chapel step. The scar has not yet been asked its opinion.

wax_tablet.name: Wax Tablet
wax_tablet.flavour: Smooth, scratched, smoothed again. A name lasts exactly until the thumb.

quill_bundle.name: Bundle of Quills
quill_bundle.flavour: Goose, mostly. The scribes swear they can tell the geese apart.

chapel_wafers.name: Chapel Wafers
chapel_wafers.flavour: Thin, pale, and sold by the dozen. They taste of resolve.

coopers_hoops.name: Coil of Cooper's Hoops
coopers_hoops.flavour: Ash, split and bent. Every barrel in town is two parts wood and one part argument.

chisel_set.name: Set of Chisels
chisel_set.flavour: Four edges, one mallet, and a bench that nobody else is allowed to lean on.

lampblack.name: Pot of Lampblack
lampblack.flavour: Soot ground in fat. The signwright's whole palette, and the smith's whole shirt.

smith_hammer.name: Smith's Hammer
smith_hammer.flavour: Cross-peen, ash haft. It remembers who swung it.

gambeson.name: Quilted Gambeson
gambeson.flavour: Linen and wool, stitched in rows. It stops a blade by being a lot of cloth.

hardtack.name: Bundle of Hardtack
hardtack.flavour: Twice-baked. The garrison has a saying about its teeth.

practice_sword.name: Wooden Practice Sword
practice_sword.flavour: Weighted with lead. The Commander says it builds character, and wrists.

sentry_cloak.name: Sentry's Cloak
sentry_cloak.flavour: Grey wool, hood deep. Made so a man can stand still in the rain.

bone_dice.name: Bone Dice
bone_dice.flavour: A pair, true enough. Market-day luck is cheap; losing is dearer.

lavender_sachet.name: Lavender Sachet
lavender_sachet.flavour: Dried, sewn, tucked in the linen. A market town can afford a pleasant drawer.

hair_pins.name: Box of Hair Pins
hair_pins.flavour: Bone and brass. They vanish at the same rate as the buttons.

cinnamon.name: Bundle of Cinnamon
cinnamon.flavour: Rolled bark from somewhere hot. The cooks guard it like a lord's ring.

mason_trowel.name: Mason's Trowel
mason_trowel.flavour: Flat, bright, and quick. A wall is laid one trowel at a time.

wall_brazier.name: Wall Brazier
wall_brazier.flavour: Iron basket on a bracket. The night watch counts its coals like coin.

gate_bolt.name: Iron Gate Bolt
gate_bolt.flavour: Shot home with a clang that the whole street takes personally.

sharpened_stakes.name: Bundle of Stakes
sharpened_stakes.flavour: Ash, fire-hardened, pointed. Planted in the ditch before the wall is dry.

counting_frame.name: Counting Frame
counting_frame.flavour: Beads on wires. The guild's clerk has opinions about the clack.

pewter_inkstand.name: Pewter Inkstand
pewter_inkstand.flavour: Two wells, one tray. Someone in town has finally learned to blot.

seal_ring.name: Signet Ring
seal_ring.flavour: A tiny crest pressed in wax. Bellmire has crests now, and rings to put them on.

embroidered_cushion.name: Embroidered Cushion
embroidered_cushion.flavour: Stuffed with feathers and stitched with a hunt. For sitting, and for being seen sitting.

velvet_cap.name: Velvet Cap
velvet_cap.flavour: Dyed deep, brimmed soft. Worn by men who lately owned one hat between them.

crystal_decanter.name: Crystal Decanter
crystal_decanter.flavour: Cut to throw light across the table. The wine inside is the lesser attraction.

ivory_horn.name: Ivory Hunting Horn
ivory_horn.flavour: Carved, banded in silver. Nobody here hunts. Everybody here would like to be asked.

perfumed_gloves.name: Pair of Perfumed Gloves
perfumed_gloves.flavour: Scented kid, thin as a rumour. The smell reaches the room before the hand.

tinderbox.name: Tinderbox
tinderbox.flavour: Flint, steel, char cloth. Cold fingers bless it.

wading_staff.name: Wading Staff
wading_staff.flavour: Ash pole. Test the Ford before the Ford tests you.

barley_broth.name: Bowl of Barley Broth
barley_broth.flavour: Thin, hot, honest. Nobody asks what else is in it.

mud_clogs.name: Pair of Mud Clogs
mud_clogs.flavour: Wooden soles. The mire takes everything else.

reed_basket.name: Reed Basket
reed_basket.flavour: Woven on the bank. Smells of river, holds a day's catch.

bramble_jam.name: Pot of Bramble Jam
bramble_jam.flavour: Sweet, seedy, and paid for in scratches.

goose.name: Live Goose
goose.flavour: Better than a hound at the gate, and worse at being told no.

butter_churn.name: Butter Churn
butter_churn.flavour: Forty minutes of arm for a pat of butter. The hamlet calls it prayer.

seed_packet.name: Packet of Seed
seed_packet.flavour: A whole year, folded into a twist of cloth.

wattle_panel.name: Wattle Panel
wattle_panel.flavour: Hazel withies, woven tight. Fences a pig, a rumour, or a quarrel.

pot_barley.name: Sack of Pot Barley
pot_barley.flavour: Pearled by hand. Stews take it and ask for more.

inkhorn.name: Inkhorn
inkhorn.flavour: A cow's horn with a stopper. The guild writes in it.

chalk_line.name: Chalk Line
chalk_line.flavour: Snapped taut, it turns a crooked argument straight.

waybill_book.name: Waybill Book
waybill_book.flavour: Every load named, every carter signed.

bale_tags.name: Bundle of Bale Tags
bale_tags.flavour: Lead seals stamped with the post's mark.

brass_dividers.name: Brass Dividers
brass_dividers.flavour: For maps, for measuring, for looking busy at a counter.

guild_sash.name: Guild Sash
guild_sash.flavour: Worn across the chest. Opens doors, or at least stops questions.

smoked_ham.name: Smoked Ham
smoked_ham.flavour: Hung in the rafters since the thaw. Patience, cut thin.

cider_jug.name: Jug of Cider
cider_jug.flavour: Cloudy, sharp, and cheaper than the ale.

dried_apples.name: String of Dried Apples
dried_apples.flavour: Leather and sweetness. They keep until spring.

sheepskin.name: Sheepskin
sheepskin.flavour: Warm underfoot, warmer round the shoulders.

rye_loaf.name: Rye Loaf
rye_loaf.flavour: Dark, dense, and a day's walk in every slice.

scarecrow.name: Straw Scarecrow
scarecrow.flavour: Fewer crows. More opinions about the crows.

gingerbread.name: Gingerbread Man
gingerbread.flavour: Sold by the fair, eaten by the first to turn a back.

market_stool.name: Three-legged Stool
market_stool.flavour: Stands anywhere. Falls over only when the seller is watching.

juggling_balls.name: Set of Juggling Balls
juggling_balls.flavour: Stuffed leather. Three stay up; the fourth is a lesson.

bunting.name: Strand of Bunting
bunting.flavour: Scraps of dyed cloth on a string. A street becomes a fair.

hand_bell.name: Hand Bell
hand_bell.flavour: Rung for the crier and the cheapest of bargains.

chapmans_pack.name: Chapman's Pack
chapmans_pack.flavour: A peddler's whole shop, strapped to one back.

taper_box.name: Box of Tapers
taper_box.flavour: Thin wax, long burn. For the quiet hours.

hymn_sheet.name: Hymn Sheet
hymn_sheet.flavour: Words for the congregation. The tunes you must find yourself.

alms_bowl.name: Alms Bowl
alms_bowl.flavour: Wooden, worn smooth by hands that gave and hands that took.

linen_shroud.name: Linen Shroud
linen_shroud.flavour: Plain, clean, sewn by the hospitallers. The wall's dead are not buried bare.

pilgrim_badge.name: Pilgrim's Badge
pilgrim_badge.flavour: Tin, stamped with the chapel door. Proof you came.

cassock.name: Plain Cassock
cassock.flavour: Black wool, long hem. Mud hides in it politely.

wood_plane.name: Wood Plane
wood_plane.flavour: Curls of oak and a finished edge.

spokeshave.name: Spokeshave
spokeshave.flavour: For wheel and chair and the rounded things between.

loom_shuttle.name: Loom Shuttle
loom_shuttle.flavour: Boxwood, polished by a thousand passes.

mallet.name: Joiner's Mallet
mallet.flavour: Persuades a joint. Argues with a thumb.

thimble.name: Brass Thimble
thimble.flavour: Small, pitted, priceless to the one who has it.

measuring_rod.name: Measuring Rod
measuring_rod.flavour: A fixed length, so a dispute has somewhere to end.

gorget.name: Steel Gorget
gorget.flavour: Guards the throat. The Commander insists.

sword_belt.name: Sword Belt
sword_belt.flavour: Stiff leather, a heavy buckle, a hanger for hope.

signal_flag.name: Signal Flag
signal_flag.flavour: Red for danger, white for the kettle.

muster_roll.name: Muster Roll
muster_roll.flavour: Every name the watch can count on. Every name it can't.

barracks_blanket.name: Barracks Blanket
barracks_blanket.flavour: Grey, scratchy, drawn tight enough to bounce a coin.

sentry_lantern.name: Sentry Lantern
sentry_lantern.flavour: Shuttered, so the light goes where the watch looks.

nutmeg.name: Whole Nutmeg
nutmeg.flavour: A speck of somewhere sunny, worth a fortnight of wages.

raisins.name: Bag of Raisins
raisins.flavour: Sun-dried and sold by the handful, ashamedly.

marzipan.name: Marzipan Sweet
marzipan.flavour: Almond and sugar, shaped like a swan. Too nice to eat. Eaten.

coral_beads.name: Coral Beads
coral_beads.flavour: Red as a wound, smooth as a vow.

painted_fan.name: Painted Fan
painted_fan.flavour: A court lady's gesture in paper and paint.

pepper_mill.name: Pepper Mill
pepper_mill.flavour: Turn it twice. The room goes quiet with respect.

plumb_bob.name: Plumb Bob
plumb_bob.flavour: A lead weight on a line. The wall obeys it.

whitewash_bucket.name: Bucket of Whitewash
whitewash_bucket.flavour: Lime and water. Even a battlement wants to look innocent.

arrow_loop_shutter.name: Arrow-loop Shutter
arrow_loop_shutter.flavour: Closes the slit in the rain. Opens it on bad news.

watchman_rattle.name: Watchman's Rattle
watchman_rattle.flavour: Loud enough to wake the dead, which is handy on a wall.

portcullis_grease.name: Tub of Portcullis Grease
portcullis_grease.flavour: Rancid tallow. The gate slides, and so does the hour.

apothecary_scales.name: Apothecary Scales
apothecary_scales.flavour: A grain too much is a poison. A grain too little is a prayer.

quill_knife.name: Quill Knife
quill_knife.flavour: Sharp enough to cut a pen, a thread, or a rumour.

folding_stool.name: Folding Stool
folding_stool.flavour: Brought to every council that expects a long afternoon.

satin_ribbon.name: Satin Ribbon
satin_ribbon.flavour: Slides through the fingers like a secret.

candle_snuffer.name: Candle Snuffer
candle_snuffer.flavour: Brass, bell-shaped. The last word at the end of a banquet.

jewel_casket.name: Jewel Casket
jewel_casket.flavour: Inlaid wood, a locked lid. Empty, until someone fills it.

silk_slippers.name: Pair of Silk Slippers
silk_slippers.flavour: Made for a floor that has never known the mire.

pearl_pin.name: Pearl Pin
pearl_pin.flavour: A drop of the sea on a spike of gold.

ermine_trim.name: Ermine Trim
ermine_trim.flavour: White, black-tipped, and ruinous in the rain.

harp_strings.name: Harp Strings
harp_strings.flavour: Gut and wire, tuned by those with an evening to spare.

gilt_candlestick.name: Gilt Candlestick
gilt_candlestick.flavour: Holds a light that is nobody's business but the host's.

trader_cargo._note_tier: Each entry also carries "tier": the growth tier at which a caravan first hauls this cargo, 1-12, matching lore_lines.growth_tiers. Same gate as stock_by_tier.cargo_adds (generated together, must agree) - here so a caravan can be loaded with cargo.tier <= town_tier without a reverse map. Cumulative. A tier-1 crossing has no caravans at all. Added C-cycle 7.
trader_cargo._note: Trader caravan cargo (D35/D39) - what a caravan carries and what bandits want. Higher value, worth losing. Keyed {name,cost,flavour}. Dead until wired.

spice.name: Crate of Spice
spice.flavour: From downriver. Smells of somewhere warmer than here.

pigiron.name: Pig Iron
pigiron.flavour: Bar stock for the smiths. Heavy, dull, wanted.

silk.name: Bale of Silk
silk.flavour: Too fine for Bellmire, which is exactly why it sells.

wine.name: Cask of Wine
wine.flavour: The real stuff, not the tavern's.

saltblock.name: Block of Salt
saltblock.flavour: A caravan's fortune in one white brick.

simples.name: Chest of Simples
simples.flavour: The apothecary's standing order. Guard it.

timber.name: Load of Seasoned Timber
timber.flavour: Good beams - the kind the masons cannot cut fast enough.

furs.name: Pack of Furs
furs.flavour: From the high country. Warm, and worth a raid.

scarglass.name: Crate of Scarglass
scarglass.flavour: Hauled up from below and sold above. Only slightly cursed.

seedcorn.name: Sacks of Seed Corn
seedcorn.flavour: Next year's bread, riding in this year's cart.

incense.name: Casket of Incense
incense.flavour: For the chapel. It makes the scar smell like somewhere holy.

tools.name: Crate of Fine Tools
tools.flavour: Chisels, files, calipers. A craft row cannot be built by hand.

copperware.name: Crate of Copperware
copperware.flavour: Pots that outlive the cook. Bandits know it too.

steelbar.name: Bundle of Steel Bar
steelbar.flavour: Proper steel, not bog iron. The garrison has first claim.

warhorses.name: String of Warhorses
warhorses.flavour: Four of them, led not ridden. Worth more than the cart and crew.

dyestuff.name: Barrel of Dyestuff
dyestuff.flavour: Woad and madder. Colour is the first luxury a town buys.

books.name: Chest of Books
books.flavour: Twelve of them. More words than most of Bellmire has ever seen.

charcoal.name: Load of Charcoal
charcoal.flavour: Burnt slow in the hills and hauled down by the sack. The forge eats it.

rawhides.name: Bundle of Raw Hides
rawhides.flavour: Still smelling of the beast. The tanner pays before he looks.

oiljars.name: Jars of Lamp Oil
oiljars.flavour: Forty jars, straw-packed. One broken jar can take the whole cart.

chapel_plate.name: Case of Chapel Plate
chapel_plate.flavour: Silver for the altar. Bandits are not particular about blessings.

candlewax.name: Barrels of Beeswax
candlewax.flavour: Chapel grade - the only candle that does not smell of the kill.

millstones.name: Pair of Millstones
millstones.flavour: Two tons of cut grit. Nobody steals these; they just stop the cart.

mail_shirts.name: Bundle of Mail Shirts
mail_shirts.flavour: Riveted, oiled, rolled in sacking. The garrison counts the rings.

sugarloaf.name: Loaves of Sugar
sugarloaf.flavour: White, hard, and worth a knife shaped for nothing else.

parchment_bales.name: Bales of Parchment
parchment_bales.flavour: The Chronicle's standing order, and the scribes' whole year.

cut_stone.name: Wagon of Cut Stone
cut_stone.flavour: Squared at the quarry. A wall is paid for one wagon at a time.

mirrorglass.name: Crate of Mirror Glass
mirrorglass.flavour: Packed face to face. Seven years of bad luck a sheet.

goldwork.name: Casket of Goldwork
goldwork.flavour: Chains, clasps, and a coronet nobody in Bellmire has the neck for.

salt_fish.name: Barrels of Salt Fish
salt_fish.flavour: Downriver catch in brine. It outlasts the winter and the appetite.

lime.name: Casks of Quicklime
lime.flavour: For the mortar. It burns the hands of anyone who hurries.

spiced_wine.name: Butts of Spiced Wine
spiced_wine.flavour: Brought up for the guild's table and guarded like the guild's gold.

plough_irons.name: Crate of Plough Irons
plough_irons.flavour: Share and coulter, carted in. The wood is local; the iron never is.

wheel_rims.name: Bundle of Wheel Rims
wheel_rims.flavour: Iron hoops for the wheelwright. A cart is mostly other people's work.

tanbark.name: Load of Tanbark
tanbark.flavour: Oak bark for the tannery. Cheap to steal, miserable to carry.

crockery_crates.name: Crates of Crockery
crockery_crates.flavour: Packed in straw. Half of it arrives as half of it.

chapel_bell.name: Chapel Bell
chapel_bell.flavour: Cast downriver, hauled up by six oxen, and it still has no clapper.

anvils.name: Pair of Anvils
anvils.flavour: Craft Row ordered two. Craft Row will fight for two.

window_lead.name: Rolls of Window Lead
window_lead.flavour: Came up for the chapel glass and stayed for the roofs.

crossbows.name: Chest of Crossbows
crossbows.flavour: Garrison order, sealed. The seal is the only thing bandits respect.

war_harness.name: Bundle of War Harness
war_harness.flavour: Straps, buckles, and the smell of a better stable than ours.

dried_fruit.name: Crates of Dried Fruit
dried_fruit.flavour: Figs, dates, apricots. The market town learned the words this year.

linen_bales.name: Bales of Fine Linen
linen_bales.flavour: Woven somewhere flat and sunny. Bellmire is neither.

iron_grating.name: Load of Iron Grating
iron_grating.flavour: For the gate and for the drains. Both keep things out.

lens_blanks.name: Case of Lens Blanks
lens_blanks.flavour: Ground glass for spectacles. Worth more than the cart under it.

amber.name: Casket of Amber
amber.flavour: Sea-stone from a coast nobody here has seen. Warm in the hand.

coin_chest.name: Sealed Coin Chest
coin_chest.flavour: The guild's own, under seal, with four guards who pretend it is grain.

ox_yokes.name: Crate of Ox Yokes
ox_yokes.flavour: Shaped elsewhere by a man who never meets the ox. They fit anyway.

nail_kegs.name: Kegs of Nails
nail_kegs.flavour: Dull, heavy, and the first thing a burned-out row asks the road for.

seed_flax.name: Flax Seed
seed_flax.flavour: Next year's cloth, riding in a sack this year. Bandits never bother with it.

hide_bales.name: Bales of Hide
hide_bales.flavour: Stiff, stinking, and worth a month of somebody's work once the tanner has them.

market_scales.name: Crate of Scales
market_scales.flavour: Beam and pan, packed in straw. A market day runs on being believed.

salt_barrels.name: Barrels of Salt
salt_barrels.flavour: Keeps meat, keeps fish, keeps a town through a bad winter. Worth stealing.

votive_wax.name: Votive Wax
votive_wax.flavour: Blocks of it, pale as a knuckle. The chapel burns more than the town expects.

psalter_crates.name: Crate of Psalters
psalter_crates.flavour: Copied downriver by hands that never saw Bellmire. Still, they name the river.

forge_coal.name: Forge Coal
forge_coal.flavour: Burns hotter than anything cut from the fen. Craft Row is built on it.

rivet_stock.name: Rivet Stock
rivet_stock.flavour: Drawn wire by the coil. It becomes a thousand small things nobody praises.

pike_staves.name: Pike Staves
pike_staves.flavour: Ash, straight-grained, cut long. The heads are fitted here, where they are needed.

shield_blanks.name: Shield Blanks
shield_blanks.flavour: Unpainted limewood. The Garrison paints them itself, and never the same twice.

ginger_crates.name: Crate of Ginger
ginger_crates.flavour: Worth more than the cart. The carter sleeps on it and says he does not.

pepper_sacks.name: Sacks of Pepper
pepper_sacks.flavour: Weighed against silver in better towns. Here it is weighed against silver too.

crane_cordage.name: Crane Cordage
crane_cordage.flavour: Coil on coil of it. A wall goes up at the speed the rope allows.

quarry_wedges.name: Quarry Wedges
quarry_wedges.flavour: Iron and oak. They split the stone the wall is counted in.

paving_stone.name: Dressed Paving Stone
paving_stone.flavour: Squared at the quarry, hauled slow. Every street costs a season of these.

lead_pipe.name: Lead Pipe
lead_pipe.flavour: For the conduits. The town argues about the cost and lays it anyway.

ivory_combs.name: Ivory Combs
ivory_combs.flavour: Cargo that exists to prove the road is safe enough to carry it.

gilt_frames.name: Gilt Frames
gilt_frames.flavour: Gold leaf over nothing much. The point was never the wood.

sickles.name: Crate of Sickles
sickles.flavour: Curved iron for the harvest. The raiders prefer them in the hand of the harvester.

oatmeal.name: Sacks of Oatmeal
oatmeal.flavour: Stone-ground and sewn tight. A hamlet's winter in a cart.

rough_cloth.name: Bolts of Rough Cloth
rough_cloth.flavour: Undyed, undersized, and bought by the yard. The tailor groans.

hemp_bundles.name: Bundles of Hemp
hemp_bundles.flavour: Retted, scutched, and baled. The rope-walk starts here.

tar_barrels.name: Barrels of Tar
tar_barrels.flavour: Pine tar, black and sticky. It seals boats and ruins hands.

guild_post_bag.name: Guild Post Bag
guild_post_bag.flavour: Sealed letters, sealed twice. Bandits cut it open to see what a post is worth.

cider_casks.name: Casks of Cider
cider_casks.flavour: Pressed in the orchards downriver. Sharp, cloudy, and half gone by the ford.

wool_fleeces.name: Bags of Wool Fleece
wool_fleeces.flavour: Greasy, matted, and valuable. The spinners pay before they sniff.

cheese_wheels.name: Cart of Cheese Wheels
cheese_wheels.flavour: Waxed rounds, stacked high. The wagon smells like a larder on wheels.

strong_ale.name: Casks of Strong Ale
strong_ale.flavour: For the market-day tavern. It does not survive the journey if the guards are thirsty.

lace_ribbon.name: Bolts of Lace and Ribbon
lace_ribbon.flavour: Light, bright, and worth more than they weigh. A raid for vanity.

live_poultry.name: Cages of Poultry
live_poultry.flavour: Forty hens, eleven geese, one very loud cockerel. Raiders hate them.

holy_oil.name: Barrels of Holy Oil
holy_oil.flavour: Pressed and blessed downriver. The chapel counts every drop.

reliquary_box.name: Reliquary Box
reliquary_box.flavour: A saint's knuckle in a silver case. Whose saint is a matter for the scribes.

black_cloth.name: Crates of Black Cloth
black_cloth.flavour: Mourning wool for the chapel and the mason. The scar keeps both busy.

files_rasps.name: Crate of Files and Rasps
files_rasps.flavour: Hardened steel, wrapped in oiled cloth. A craft row eats files like bread.

lead_pigs.name: Pigs of Lead
lead_pigs.flavour: Grey bars, soft and heavy. The glaziers and the bad-tempered both want them.

bar_copper.name: Bundle of Bar Copper
bar_copper.flavour: Bright when cut, green by autumn. The coppersmith hovers at the road.

arrowheads.name: Crates of Arrowheads
arrowheads.flavour: Bodkin and broad, a thousand to the crate. The garrison counts them out.

helm_plate.name: Bundle of Helm Plate
helm_plate.flavour: Beaten flat and waiting for a smith. Every dent starts here.

hardtack_sacks.name: Sacks of Hardtack
hardtack_sacks.flavour: Rations for the wall. It will outlast the war and the teeth.

dyed_wool.name: Bolts of Dyed Wool
dyed_wool.flavour: Madder red and woad blue. The first colour the guild ever imported.

honey_mead.name: Casks of Honey Mead
honey_mead.flavour: Gold, sweet, and strong. A drover's pay, drunk in one night.

painted_pottery.name: Crate of Painted Pottery
painted_pottery.flavour: Glazed in colours the Row cannot match. It rides in straw and anxiety.

gate_chain.name: Coils of Gate Chain
gate_chain.flavour: Iron links the width of a wrist. The gate will not stand without it.

gate_beams.name: Gate-grade Oak Beams
gate_beams.flavour: Black oak, seasoned long. Cut for the one wall that must not fall.

iron_cauldrons.name: Boiler Cauldrons
iron_cauldrons.flavour: For pitch and for oil. The wall prepares for guests it does not invite.

window_panes.name: Cases of Window Panes
window_panes.flavour: Greenish glass, packed on edge. One pothole and the cart is a bell.

brocade.name: Rolls of Brocade
brocade.flavour: Figured silk-and-wool. It is hauled to a town that can finally afford to look.

pewterware.name: Crate of Pewterware
pewterware.flavour: Plates, tankards, a ewer. Matching, which is the whole offence.

velvet_bolts.name: Bolts of Velvet
velvet_bolts.flavour: Deep pile, deeper pockets. The guild wears it to remind itself it won.

southern_wine.name: Casks of Southern Wine
southern_wine.flavour: Sun-ripened somewhere with no mire. Guarded as if it could bleed.

perfume_phials.name: Crate of Perfume Phials
perfume_phials.flavour: Crystal bottles in sawdust. Raiders sniff first, take second.

barley_seed.name: Sacks of Barley Seed
barley_seed.flavour: Next year, bagged. Raiders eat first and plant never.

bee_skeps.name: Crates of Bee Skeps
bee_skeps.flavour: Straw hives. Handle gently, they say, and the bees agree.

flax_sheaves.name: Retted Flax Sheaves
flax_sheaves.flavour: Soaked and stinking, treasured by every spinner.

hurdle_bundles.name: Bundled Hurdles
hurdle_bundles.flavour: Woven fence for the sheep. Bandits rarely want the fence.

tin_ingots.name: Tin Ingots
tin_ingots.flavour: Pale, soft, and wanted by every bronzesmith.

ore_sacks.name: Sacks of Iron Ore
ore_sacks.flavour: Heavy, rust-brown, worth the cart that bears it.

grindstones.name: Grindstones
grindstones.flavour: Round, grey, and impossible to hide.

cart_axles.name: Oak Cart Axles
cart_axles.flavour: Spares for a road that breaks them.

tallow_casks.name: Casks of Tallow
tallow_casks.flavour: Rendered fat, sealed in oak. It stinks. It lights a village.

herring_barrels.name: Barrels of Herring
herring_barrels.flavour: Salted at the coast, hauled upriver, opened with a sigh.

pig_drove.name: Drove of Pigs
pig_drove.flavour: Eight pigs and a boy with a stick. Raiders take the pigs; the boy knows better.

beeswax_slabs.name: Slabs of Beeswax
beeswax_slabs.flavour: Golden bricks. The chapel will want them later.

pavilion_canvas.name: Pavilion Canvas
pavilion_canvas.flavour: Folded sailcloth for a fair that has not yet been held.

mummers_chests.name: Mummers' Costume Chests
mummers_chests.flavour: Masks, tinsel, one very sorry dragon.

coopered_kegs.name: Coopered Kegs
coopered_kegs.flavour: Empty, until the alehouse fills them.

caged_songbirds.name: Crate of Caged Songbirds
caged_songbirds.flavour: Finches for the market. They sing to bandits too.

altar_cloths.name: Altar Cloths
altar_cloths.flavour: Embroidered by hospitaller hands. Stained only by wax.

wafer_flour.name: Sacks of Wafer Flour
wafer_flour.flavour: White flour, kept dry, blessed by the baker.

tithe_barley.name: Tithe Barley
tithe_barley.flavour: A tenth, measured out, bound for the chapel loft.

stone_font_blanks.name: Stone Font Blanks
stone_font_blanks.flavour: Rough basins. The mason has yet to make them holy.

loom_frames.name: Crated Loom Frames
loom_frames.flavour: Flat-packed beams, a weaver's whole future.

ironmongery.name: Crates of Ironmongery
ironmongery.flavour: Hinges, latches, hooks. The small things that hold a house up.

cartwheels.name: Spare Cartwheels
cartwheels.flavour: Spoked oak, banded in iron. A wheel too many is a wheel saved.

tanned_hides.name: Tanned Hides
tanned_hides.flavour: Supple, dark, and smelling of the tannery downwind.

garrison_tents.name: Garrison Tents
garrison_tents.flavour: Heavy canvas and tent pegs. The watch sleeps dry.

bolt_crates.name: Crates of Crossbow Bolts
bolt_crates.flavour: Ten dozen to a crate. Count them on arrival.

saddle_leather.name: Saddle Leather
saddle_leather.flavour: Oiled, stitched, and wanted by every rider in the Garrison.

saffron_threads.name: Saffron Threads
saffron_threads.flavour: Worth more than their weight in silver. Guarded as if they know it.

clove_crates.name: Crates of Cloves
clove_crates.flavour: Brown, sharp, and stronger than most opinions.

almond_sacks.name: Sacks of Almonds
almond_sacks.flavour: Carried from the south, spilled only by bandits.

raisin_casks.name: Casks of Raisins
raisin_casks.flavour: Sun-dried sweetness in oak. The wagon smells of a feast day.

ashlar_blocks.name: Ashlar Blocks
ashlar_blocks.flavour: Dressed stone, squared, ready for the wall.

oak_hoarding.name: Oak Hoarding Timbers
oak_hoarding.flavour: The wooden galleries of a wall that fears a siege.

kiln_coal.name: Kiln Coal
kiln_coal.flavour: Black fuel for lime, and for the bricks that follow.

satin_bolts.name: Bolts of Satin
satin_bolts.flavour: Slick as water, dear as wine.

ink_barrels.name: Barrels of Ink
ink_barrels.flavour: Oak-gall black. The clerks would drink it if you let them.

map_rolls.name: Rolls of Maps
map_rolls.flavour: Drawn by travellers, a few of whom even returned.

copper_stills.name: Copper Stills
copper_stills.flavour: Alembics for the apothecary. Bright, bulging, easy to dent.

pearl_strings.name: Strings of Pearls
pearl_strings.flavour: Matched, graded, and guarded by two men who rarely blink.

gold_thread.name: Spools of Gold Thread
gold_thread.flavour: Spun fine for vestments. The wagon is lighter than the guard's mood.

ermine_pelts.name: Ermine Pelts
ermine_pelts.flavour: White winter coats, taken by the dozen. Judges and kings pay for them.

cut_gems.name: Casket of Cut Gems
cut_gems.flavour: Garnet, jasper, one wicked sapphire. The wagon has a second lock.

stock_by_tier._note: Stock gating by growth tier (D35/D39 + D31/D32). Tiers are the 12 stages of lore_lines.growth_tiers.tiers, in order, 1-12. CUMULATIVE: a town at tier N shows every shop_adds key from tiers 1..N, and caravans carry every cargo_adds key from tiers 1..N. Nothing is ever removed as the town grows. Every key here exists in shop_stock / trader_cargo above. A crossing must not sell glass. Dead until wired.

equipment._note: C7 equipment catalogue. weapons/armour are named pieces keyed by id. 'tier' is the index into gear.gd WEAPONS / ARMOUR (0-5); 'tier_name' repeats that ladder's name for readability. NO costs/atk/hp/ac are stated here - those stay in gear.gd. 'routes' lists every way a piece can be produced: looted (floor/lord drop), forged (gold at the forge), shop (shop stock, gated by shop level), caravan (only ever carried by a trade caravan, may exceed the town cap), starting (a calling's kit, never purchasable). Tier 5 pieces are FOUND-only (routes = looted only). 'family' is blade/axe/arcane/ranged, or 'open' for the monk. Armour 'cut' is robe/light/heavy so casters and heavies can be dressed differently. starting_kits maps each of the fifteen callings to one plain weapon + one plain armour id; kit pieces sit at tier 0 so they never out-perform the first bought tier (D64/D65). Dead until wired.

w_blade_ironmonger.name: Ironmonger's Blade
w_blade_ironmonger.flavour: Straight, grey, honest. Cut from the same bar as the town's hinges.

w_blade_ford_cutlass.name: Ford Cutlass
w_blade_ford_cutlass.flavour: Shorter than a sword, longer than an excuse.

w_blade_militia_sabre.name: Militia Sabre
w_blade_militia_sabre.flavour: Issued by the guild in a hundred. Kept by about forty.

w_blade_guildmarked.name: Guild-Marked Longsword
w_blade_guildmarked.flavour: The stamp on the ricasso is the only thing about it that is showy.

w_blade_heron_fold.name: Heron-Folded Blade
w_blade_heron_fold.flavour: Folded nine times by a smith who would not say why nine.

w_blade_bellwright.name: Bellwright's Falchion
w_blade_bellwright.flavour: Heavy at the tip, like a bell is heavy at the lip. It rings when it lands.

w_blade_stonewick.name: Stonewick Backsword
w_blade_stonewick.flavour: Taken from a dead captain's hand. One edge only, by design.

w_blade_emberline.name: Emberline Sword
w_blade_emberline.flavour: The runes sulk orange in the dark and brighten when something wants you dead.

w_blade_lamplit.name: Lamplit Runeblade
w_blade_lamplit.flavour: Warm to hold. The chandler swears it is only the lamp-oil in the grip.

w_blade_stitchwound.name: Stitchwound Sabre
w_blade_stitchwound.flavour: Its edge leaves a line that looks sewn shut. It is not kind about it.

w_blade_ferryman_rune.name: Ferryman's Rune-Blade
w_blade_ferryman_rune.flavour: Runed in a southern yard. Carried north on the one wagon that did not turn back.

w_blade_wyrmfang.name: Wyrmfang Longsword
w_blade_wyrmfang.flavour: Hilted around a tooth the length of a forearm. Cold-white when it swings.

w_blade_ashdrake.name: Tooth of the Ash Drake
w_blade_ashdrake.flavour: Pulled from a jaw below. The dragon asked for it back. Nobody answered.

w_blade_coldbrand.name: Cold-White Brand
w_blade_coldbrand.flavour: No wagon-master would say where he bought it. All of them paid in full.

w_blade_sunderfang.name: Sunderfang
w_blade_sunderfang.flavour: Forged by a town that can finally afford to be afraid of its own sword.

w_blade_scarfang.name: Scarfang
w_blade_scarfang.flavour: Grew in the scar's wild magic. Violet at the edge, and it hums when the seam opens.

w_blade_seamedge.name: Seam-Edge
w_blade_seamedge.flavour: It cuts along the line a thing was always going to break. The scar did the teaching.

w_blade_fishwife_knife.name: Fishwife's Knife
w_blade_fishwife_knife.flavour: Gutted ten thousand eels before anyone pointed it at anything else.

w_blade_watchman_dagger.name: Watchman's Dagger
w_blade_watchman_dagger.flavour: Worn bright on one side where the thumb goes. The other side is not worn.

w_blade_ropecutter_knife.name: Ropecutter's Knife
w_blade_ropecutter_knife.flavour: Made to part a line in one pull. Does the same for a belt.

w_blade_guild_stamped_dagger.name: Guild-Stamped Dagger
w_blade_guild_stamped_dagger.flavour: Stamped, numbered and entered in a ledger. Someone will ask where it went.

w_blade_chandler_wick_knife.name: Chandler's Wick-Knife
w_blade_chandler_wick_knife.flavour: Made to trim a wick. A good smith made it, so it trims other things as well.

w_blade_sallow_gate_dagger.name: Sallow-Gate Dagger
w_blade_sallow_gate_dagger.flavour: Carried by the gate-ward who counted every coin in. Found with none on him.

w_blade_lamp_etched_dagger.name: Lamp-Etched Dagger
w_blade_lamp_etched_dagger.flavour: Etched by the lampwright, small and even. The runes are paid for and look it.

w_blade_bellsteel_knife.name: Bellsteel Knife
w_blade_bellsteel_knife.flavour: Cast from the bell that cracked in the second winter. It still keeps a note.

w_blade_seam_parting_dagger.name: Seam-Parting Dagger
w_blade_seam_parting_dagger.flavour: Parts a seam clean. What was sewn there does not stay sewn.

w_axe_woodsman.name: Woodsman's Hatchet
w_axe_woodsman.flavour: Meant for kindling. Has opinions about skulls.

w_axe_hewers_axe.name: Hewer's Axe
w_axe_hewers_axe.flavour: One bad winter's worth of firewood is stamped into the haft.

w_axe_toll_cleaver.name: Toll Cleaver
w_axe_toll_cleaver.flavour: Square-bladed. Forgot what it was for and became a weapon.

w_axe_woodyard_greataxe.name: Woodyard Greataxe
w_axe_woodyard_greataxe.flavour: Two blades, one haft, no pretence. Bought off the yard by the cord.

w_axe_charcoal_greataxe.name: Charcoal-Burner's Greataxe
w_axe_charcoal_greataxe.flavour: Black to the haft from the burner's hands. Splits a log in one and a door in two.

w_axe_millstone_axe.name: Millstone Axe
w_axe_millstone_axe.flavour: Ground on the old mill-wheel. The edge never quite stops singing.

w_axe_bearded_greataxe.name: Bearded Greataxe
w_axe_bearded_greataxe.flavour: The beard of the blade hooks. What it hooks, it keeps.

w_axe_ferrywarden.name: Ferrywarden's Axe
w_axe_ferrywarden.flavour: Carried by the man who kept the Ford. It still smells of river.

w_axe_runed_hewer.name: Rune-Cut Hewer
w_axe_runed_hewer.flavour: The runes were carved after, with a chisel and a grudge. They took.

w_axe_emberhaft.name: Emberhaft
w_axe_emberhaft.flavour: The haft is warm all the way through. Do not ask the carpenter.

w_axe_wallbreaker.name: Wallbreaker
w_axe_wallbreaker.flavour: Brought down a stretch of palisade once. The palisade was rebuilt. The axe was not retired.

w_axe_gutterlord.name: Gutterlord's Axe
w_axe_gutterlord.flavour: A bandit's boast, forged to be carried openly. The bandit lost it on the road.

w_axe_lamp_etched_greataxe.name: Lamp-Etched Greataxe
w_axe_lamp_etched_greataxe.flavour: Etched along both bits by the lampwright. Clean work, paid for in full.

w_axe_bellyard_greataxe.name: Bell-Yard Greataxe
w_axe_bellyard_greataxe.flavour: Both heads poured in one pour at the bell-yard. The note is flat and nobody argues.

w_axe_dragontooth_axe.name: Dragontooth Axe
w_axe_dragontooth_axe.flavour: A single curve of tooth for an edge. Burns white at the swing's peak.

w_axe_wyrmsplitter.name: Wyrmsplitter
w_axe_wyrmsplitter.flavour: Nothing has been split with it yet that was not larger than a house.

w_axe_ashmaul.name: Ash-Maul Greataxe
w_axe_ashmaul.flavour: Two-handed, two-fisted, two-faced. Respected on arrival.

w_axe_scarcleaver.name: Scarcleaver
w_axe_scarcleaver.flavour: Wild magic bent the head into something that was not drawn by any smith.

w_axe_seamsplitter.name: Seamsplitter
w_axe_seamsplitter.flavour: The violet glow is the seam itself, not reflection. Hold it away from the face.

w_arcane_hazel_wand.name: Hazel Wand
w_arcane_hazel_wand.flavour: Cut from a Bellmire hedge. A hedge-witch would call it generous.

w_arcane_walking_staff.name: Hedge-Witch's Staff
w_arcane_walking_staff.flavour: Mostly a staff. Occasionally something else, usually at night.

w_arcane_tallow_rod.name: Tallow-Wrapped Rod
w_arcane_tallow_rod.flavour: The wrapping is candle-wax. The wizardry is a rumour.

w_arcane_shepherd_staff.name: Shepherd's Staff
w_arcane_shepherd_staff.flavour: Longer than a man, crooked at the top. Has moved more sheep than spells.

w_arcane_lamplighter_staff.name: Lamplighter's Staff
w_arcane_lamplighter_staff.flavour: Hook at one end for the lamp, a stub of tallow at the other. Walks the east lane every dusk.

w_arcane_ashen_staff.name: Ashen Staff
w_arcane_ashen_staff.flavour: Ash-wood, bound with ironwork the guild calls 'good enough'.

w_arcane_reed_wand.name: Reed-Singer's Wand
w_arcane_reed_wand.flavour: Hums in a wind. The hum is the spell, they say, and the spell is polite.

w_arcane_bellglass_staff.name: Bellglass Staff
w_arcane_bellglass_staff.flavour: A shard of the old bell sits in the head. It chimes at the wrong moments, usefully.

w_arcane_runewrapped_staff.name: Rune-Wrapped Staff
w_arcane_runewrapped_staff.flavour: Every rune a different handwriting. Nobody agrees who left them.

w_arcane_emberwand.name: Emberwand
w_arcane_emberwand.flavour: The tip is permanently, faintly hot. Mages call it comforting. Others stand clear.

w_arcane_scarlamp_staff.name: Scarlamp Staff
w_arcane_scarlamp_staff.flavour: Lit from below, not above. The light is not any lamp's.

w_arcane_ferryman_wand.name: Ferryman's Wand
w_arcane_ferryman_wand.flavour: A trader's gift to a customer who paid twice. It is not obvious the customer survived.

w_arcane_dragontooth_staff.name: Dragontooth Staff
w_arcane_dragontooth_staff.flavour: A drake's tooth caps the head. It listens before it burns.

w_arcane_coldflame_wand.name: Coldflame Wand
w_arcane_coldflame_wand.flavour: Burns white, gives no heat, steals some. Wagon-masters hide it under sacks.

w_arcane_ashdrake_rod.name: Ash-Drake's Rod
w_arcane_ashdrake_rod.flavour: It remembers the breath it was cut from. The remembering is the spell.

w_arcane_scarwand.name: Scarwand
w_arcane_scarwand.flavour: Grown, not carved. It points at wounds. Occasionally, at your own.

w_arcane_seam_staff.name: Staff of the Open Seam
w_arcane_seam_staff.flavour: Violet at the knot, quiet everywhere else. Do not look into the knot.

w_arcane_vestry_mace.name: Vestry Mace
w_arcane_vestry_mace.flavour: Lives behind the vestry door. Carried out for funerals and for arguments about funerals.

w_arcane_almoners_mace.name: Almoner's Mace
w_arcane_almoners_mace.flavour: Hands out the blessing and the bruise from the same end. The ledger counts both.

w_arcane_bellfounder_mace.name: Bell-Founder's Mace
w_arcane_bellfounder_mace.flavour: Poured from bell-metal off-cuts. Strikes once and rings once, which is enough.

w_arcane_lamp_chased_mace.name: Lamp-Chased Mace
w_arcane_lamp_chased_mace.flavour: Prayers chased into the head by the lampwright, a line at a time. Clean work, paid for.

w_arcane_rune_banded_mace.name: Rune-Banded Mace
w_arcane_rune_banded_mace.flavour: Three bands on the head, each in a different hand. Nobody has agreed on the third.

w_arcane_dragontooth_mace.name: Dragontooth Mace
w_arcane_dragontooth_mace.flavour: A drake's molar sets the head. The priest who blessed it asked not to be named.

w_ranged_hunters_crossbow.name: Hunter's Crossbow
w_ranged_hunters_crossbow.flavour: A hunting bow's slow cousin. Reliable, slow, rude to rabbits.

w_ranged_ford_stalker.name: Ford-Stalker's Crossbow
w_ranged_ford_stalker.flavour: Spanned by hand, aimed by habit. Smells of reeds.

w_ranged_lookout_arbalest.name: Lookout's Light Arbalest
w_ranged_lookout_arbalest.flavour: The lookouts got these when they ran out of arrows and ideas.

w_ranged_guild_arbalest.name: Guild Arbalest
w_ranged_guild_arbalest.flavour: Spanned with a goat's-foot lever. The goat is long dead; the lever endures.

w_ranged_twin_stave.name: Twin-Staved Crossbow
w_ranged_twin_stave.flavour: Two staves, one trigger. Does not forgive a loose hand.

w_ranged_reedcutter.name: Reedcutter
w_ranged_reedcutter.flavour: Slim bolt, thin string, quiet flight. Named by someone who sold it.

w_ranged_runed_arbalest.name: Runed Arbalest
w_ranged_runed_arbalest.flavour: The runes along the stock steady the aim. The aim was steady already. Nobody asked.

w_ranged_emberbolt.name: Emberbolt Crossbow
w_ranged_emberbolt.flavour: Every bolt leaves with a spark. Drawers of kindling hope.

w_ranged_warrens_thrum.name: Warren's Thrum
w_ranged_warrens_thrum.flavour: Strung with something that was not hemp. It thrums on its own.

w_ranged_ferryman_bow.name: Ferryman's Heavy Crossbow
w_ranged_ferryman_bow.flavour: Wound with a southern crank. The crank squeals, and the target takes notice.

w_ranged_dragontooth_arbalest.name: Dragontooth Arbalest
w_ranged_dragontooth_arbalest.flavour: Bolt-rail of drake-bone. Cold-white fletching ignites before it lands.

w_ranged_wyrmstring.name: Wyrmstring
w_ranged_wyrmstring.flavour: A drake's sinew for a string. It is not hemp. It is not forgiving.

w_ranged_ashbolt_great.name: Ash-Bolt Greatbow
w_ranged_ashbolt_great.flavour: The size of a door, almost. It fires bolts the length of a forearm.

w_ranged_scarbow.name: Scarbow
w_ranged_scarbow.flavour: Limbs that bent in the wild magic and never straightened. Fires something not quite a bolt.

w_ranged_seamstring.name: Seamstring
w_ranged_seamstring.flavour: Strung along the line where the scar opened. The string sings the same note it did then.

w_open_walking_quarterstaff.name: Pilgrim's Quarterstaff
w_open_walking_quarterstaff.flavour: Ash pole, iron ferrules. Hit things on the road; stay polite at the inn.

w_open_hand_wraps.name: Road-Weathered Wraps
w_open_hand_wraps.flavour: Linen, tight, stained. They know the shape of your knuckles.

w_open_banded_staff.name: Banded Quarterstaff
w_open_banded_staff.flavour: Bound at four points. Each band is a different year of practice.

w_open_ferry_knuckles.name: Ferrywatch Knuckles
w_open_ferry_knuckles.flavour: Iron over the knuckles, brass over the guilt.

w_open_runed_wraps.name: Rune-Stitched Wraps
w_open_runed_wraps.flavour: The stitching is a mantra. Say it wrong and the stitches know.

w_open_emberstaff.name: Emberstaff Quarterstaff
w_open_emberstaff.flavour: Warm at the end. Hotter, if you ask politely.

w_open_dragontooth_staff_open.name: Dragontooth Quarterstaff
w_open_dragontooth_staff_open.flavour: Tooth-capped both ends. Burns white when the flurry builds.

w_open_coldfist_wraps.name: Cold-White Wraps
w_open_coldfist_wraps.flavour: Wrapped in drake-silk. The silk bites. The fist bites back.

w_open_scarstaff_open.name: Scar-Grown Quarterstaff
w_open_scarstaff_open.flavour: Grown straight but never ordinary. The violet runs the length like a vein.

w_kit_knight.name: Worn Arming Sword
w_kit_knight.flavour: Notched, honest, a hand-me-down. It will do until you can buy better.

w_kit_warden.name: Gatekeeper's Hatchet
w_kit_warden.flavour: Meant for splitting door-bars, not skulls. It will learn.

w_kit_barbarian.name: Rough Wood-Axe
w_kit_barbarian.flavour: A felled tree's whole biography, sharpened once.

w_kit_rogue.name: Pawn-Shop Shortknife
w_kit_rogue.flavour: Bought by the pound. Sharp enough to be rude.

w_kit_ranger.name: Hunting Crossbow
w_kit_ranger.flavour: Rusted at the trigger. Never missed a thing it was pointed at, they say.

w_kit_mage.name: Ink-Stained Wand
w_kit_mage.flavour: Cut from a hedge. The ink is a mark of study, not an accident.

w_kit_sage.name: Pilgrim's Ash Staff
w_kit_sage.flavour: Taller than you. Carried for the walking, used for the praying.

w_kit_cleric.name: Parish Iron Mace
w_kit_cleric.flavour: A dented lump of consecrated iron. Heavy on the prayer.

w_kit_paladin.name: Oath-Sworn Longsword
w_kit_paladin.flavour: Second-hand. The oath is not; it was sworn fresh this morning.

w_kit_necromancer.name: Grave-Wood Stick
w_kit_necromancer.flavour: A stick from a grave, which is not the same as a staff.

w_kit_monk.name: Plain Quarterstaff
w_kit_monk.flavour: Ash and ferrule. The discipline is the weapon.

w_kit_druid.name: Hazel Gnarlstick
w_kit_druid.flavour: Alive, once. Does not seem to have noticed it is not.

w_kit_warlock.name: Pact-Scratched Wand
w_kit_warlock.flavour: The scratches are the contract. Read them and weep.

w_kit_bard.name: Stage Dagger
w_kit_bard.flavour: Looks fine from the back row. Cuts, if forced.

a_reed_robe.name: Reed-Cloth Robe
a_reed_robe.flavour: Woven for scholars with thin purses and thick patience.

a_tanners_jerkin.name: Tanner's Jerkin
a_tanners_jerkin.flavour: Stiff leather, smells of its trade. Stops a knife about half the time.

a_ford_leathers.name: Ford Leathers
a_ford_leathers.flavour: Oiled against river-damp. Creaks in cold.

a_padded_gambeson.name: Padded Gambeson
a_padded_gambeson.flavour: Quilted wool under a layer of regret. Warm, bulky, forgiving.

a_guild_vestments.name: Guild Vestments
a_guild_vestments.flavour: Stitched with the guild's thread. It means something, if you know what.

a_studded_brigandine.name: Studded Brigandine
a_studded_brigandine.flavour: Rivets in the right places. The wrong places will teach you.

a_militia_hauberk.name: Militia Hauberk
a_militia_hauberk.flavour: Issued in rows of identical rings. Fits no one equally.

a_bellwright_mail.name: Bellwright's Mail
a_bellwright_mail.flavour: Taken from a captain. The rings are mismatched in a way that looks intended.

a_runed_vestment.name: Rune-Hemmed Vestment
a_runed_vestment.flavour: The hem wards. The cuff, you suspect, merely decorates.

a_emberleather.name: Emberleather Coat
a_emberleather.flavour: Cured over a slow fire. Smells like a hearth that loves you.

a_plate_of_the_wall.name: Plate of the Wall
a_plate_of_the_wall.flavour: Hammered on the old forge, thick enough to have an opinion.

a_ferryman_plate.name: Ferryman's Plate
a_ferryman_plate.flavour: Fitted for a southern knight who stopped being one on the road north.

a_dragonsilk_robe.name: Dragonsilk Robe
a_dragonsilk_robe.flavour: Spun from something that was not a worm. It stays cool in a blaze.

a_wyrmhide_coat.name: Wyrmhide Coat
a_wyrmhide_coat.flavour: Scaled hide, hardened over a drake's own ember. Heavier than it looks.

a_warded_plate_a.name: Wardplate of the Ash Gate
a_warded_plate_a.flavour: The wards were etched by a priest who would not sign them.

a_dragontooth_hauberk.name: Dragontooth Hauberk
a_dragontooth_hauberk.flavour: Teeth for studs. White frost on the rings after a hard swing.

a_scarwoven_hauberk.name: Scarwoven Hauberk
a_scarwoven_hauberk.flavour: Wild magic knit the rings itself. It grows, a little, each time it is worn.

a_seamwoven_vestment.name: Seamwoven Vestment
a_seamwoven_vestment.flavour: Cloth that never frays. Threads the colour of a fresh bruise.

a_kit_knight.name: Patched Gambeson
a_kit_knight.flavour: Quilted wool and a smith's apology.

a_kit_warden.name: Wall-Duty Jerkin
a_kit_warden.flavour: Leather with the guild's tally scratched into the shoulder.

a_kit_barbarian.name: Hide Scraps
a_kit_barbarian.flavour: Stitched from three animals, none of them freely given.

a_kit_rogue.name: Dark Wool Cloak and Tunic
a_kit_rogue.flavour: Dull colours, deep pockets, no questions.

a_kit_duelist.name: Fencing Shirt and Waistcoat
a_kit_duelist.flavour: Starched cotton that lies about being armour.

a_kit_ranger.name: Mossy Hunting Leathers
a_kit_ranger.flavour: Weathered to the colour of a thicket.

a_kit_mage.name: Apprentice's Threadbare Robe
a_kit_mage.flavour: Three sizes too long. Learn to hem or learn to run.

a_kit_sage.name: Scribe's Plain Habit
a_kit_sage.flavour: Wool the colour of old paper, with sleeves for pens.

a_kit_cleric.name: Parish Vestments
a_kit_cleric.flavour: Washed so often the dye has faded to hope.

a_kit_paladin.name: Squire's Tabard and Padding
a_kit_paladin.flavour: A white tabard over wool. It will not stay white.

a_kit_necromancer.name: Black Mourning Robes
a_kit_necromancer.flavour: Bought secondhand from a funeral nobody remembers.

a_kit_monk.name: Undyed Linen Wrap
a_kit_monk.flavour: Simple. A little too simple. That is the point.

a_kit_druid.name: Bramble-Woven Cloak
a_kit_druid.flavour: Burrs stay in it. So does the weather.

a_kit_warlock.name: Patchwork Cloak
a_kit_warlock.flavour: Stitched from other cloaks. All of them wanted something.

a_kit_bard.name: Motley Jerkin
a_kit_bard.flavour: Colourful, cheap, and loud enough to cover for the fit.

stock_retirement._note: C-53 (C4.1). Goods that STOP being stocked as the town grows. The two earlier blocks (shop_stock.tier, trader_cargo.tier) say when a good FIRST appears; this block says the LAST growth tier (1-12, inclusive) at which it is still on a shelf or in a caravan. A good listed here is stocked for tiers first_tier..last_tier and absent from last_tier+1 onward. This SUPERSEDES the 'nothing is ever removed' line in stock_by_tier._note for the keys listed here, and for no others; unlisted goods are stocked from their first tier to tier 12. replaced_by is the good that takes its place on the same shelf (null = nothing replaces it). Every key exists in shop_stock / trader_cargo; every replaced_by costs at least as much as the good it replaces. Dead until wired.

clay_cups.why: A chapel town drinks from fired pottery; the crossing's soft clay cups stop coming off the shelf.

rush_light.why: Rush lights drip and stink. Once the guild sells wick and wax nobody buys one.
